description: §5.2.3 — a CALL-LED inline block on a button inside an engine state-child runs BOTH statements in source order: `last` is `go:5` (track ran first, before the assignment) and `count` ends 0. Pre-S437 impl#1 kept only the leading call for a call-led block (count stayed 5).
rationale: §5.2.3: "a statement's effect SHALL NOT depend on whether an earlier statement is a call or an assignment, or on whether the handler sits at top level, inside an engine state-child (§51.0.I), or inside an `<each>` row (§17.7)."
